alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 15 at 11:46PM EST by NWS Northern Indiana
alerts.description:
A rapid cooling of temperatures, lingering moisture, and light
winds will be favorable for continued patchy fog development
overnight into early Monday morning. Visibilities will be highly
variable due to the patchy nature of the fog, but at least
localized visibilities of one quarter of a mile or less are
expected. The fog is expected to dissipate after 9 AM EST Monday
morning. Motorists should be prepared for rapid changes in
visibilities across short distances.
